image_prompts.prompt: Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait cover slide for a deck about agents and complexity. In the centre, a flat illustration of a growing pile of paper rule sheets, each new sheet slightly crooked, stacked on top of a small, sturdy box labelled 'code' that sits undisturbed underneath. A thin amber loop arrow circles the pile, suggesting rules that breed more rules. A small uppercase kicker reads 'Agents and complexity'. The serif headline reads 'Every mistake added a rule'. Beneath it, one short line explains that a friend's agent verification kept breaking: the code held up, but the process around it did not. Generous cream space, a thin amber bar along the top edge, dark grey text, no people, no product logos, no numbers on the cover. Calm and editorial in tone, like a thoughtful report cover rather than an advert.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait statistics slide built around a single large amber serif number, '812', with the label 'concurrency attacks, no failures' directly beneath. Behind the number, a faint grid of tiny lightning bolt icons converges on a small shield labelled 'tool', with no cracks, to suggest many attacks and none succeeding. Under the label, a short line says that the tool under verification is fine and that what keeps breaking is the machinery around it; a few small broken gear icons sit to one side to stand for that machinery. Keep the number dominant, with plenty of space around it. No other statistics, no percentages, no charts, no logos. Dark grey text, amber used for the number and the bar at the top.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait quote slide. A large amber opening quotation mark sits at the upper left. The quotation, set in a large italic serif, reads: 'Every mistake added a rule, and every new rule caused new mistakes.' Beneath it, a small circular diagram of two flat icons joined by curved amber arrows, a warning triangle labelled 'mistake' and a paper sheet labelled 'rule', each arrow leading to the other, so the loop is visible at a glance. A small uppercase attribution reads 'The friend, in their own words'. No other text, nothing added to the quotation, lots of cream space, dark grey type, restrained use of amber.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait list slide titled 'Six patterns that kept failing'. Six horizontal cards stacked vertically, each with an amber left edge, a small flat icon and a short caption. One: a shrinking speech bubble with a skipped checklist step, 'Compaction skips mandatory steps'. Two: a terminal window with its middle torn out, 'Failing commands lose their output'. Three: a very long scroll of paper with a thought bubble, '100 KB prompts recited from memory'. Four: a script file with a pencil scribbling over it, 'Scripts edited in place'. Five: a tool suggesting a command that a rule book crosses out, 'Harness suggests what rules forbid'. Six: a small sheet sprouting more sheets, 'Rules breeding rules'. Even spacing, legible type, no logos and no extra numbers.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait slide showing a simplified Wardley map. A horizontal axis along the bottom runs left to right through four labelled stages: genesis, custom-built, product, commodity. On the left, over custom-built, a cluster of small amber circles is drawn inside a loose, lumpy outline labelled 'the blob', representing hand-built process such as output capture and recovery after compaction. Far to the right, over commodity, three neat grey circles labelled 'files', 'hashes' and 'git' sit with no lines connecting them to anything. The serif headline at the top reads 'Complexity is a position on a map'. A short line beneath explains that complexity is custom-built process sitting where commodities already exist, while files, hashes and git sit unused. Clean, sparse, legible, no extra components.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait comparison slide with the headline 'Answer a mistake with a component, not a rule'. Two side by side panels. The left panel, titled 'Add a rule', shows a prompt document getting taller, a speech bubble being squeezed by a clamp to suggest compaction, and a few rule sheets falling away; three short captions read 'The prompt grows', 'The session compacts sooner' and 'Compaction picks which rules survive'. The right panel, tinted pale amber and titled 'Ship a component', shows a small boxed component slotted into place like a puzzle piece, with a rule sheet being dropped into a bin; captions read 'The mistake stops being possible' and 'The rule can go'. Balanced panels, simple icons, no other text or numbers.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait diagram titled 'When a rule fails, use a stronger barrier'. Three rounded white boxes with amber outlines, stacked top to bottom and joined by downward amber arrows each labelled 'stronger'. The top box shows a paper rule sheet and a thought bubble, labelled 'Rule: relies on memory'. The middle box shows a transcript with a magnifying glass, labelled 'Record: detects'. The bottom box shows a closed gate or wall, labelled 'Boundary: prevents'. A short line at the foot reads 'Rules for incidents, machines for enforcement.' Clear vertical hierarchy, generous spacing, legible labels, nothing beyond these three barriers.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A portrait steps slide titled 'Where to start'. Five numbered cards stacked vertically, each with an amber number disc and a small flat icon. One: a map with a circled cluster, 'Map it and mark the custom-built blob'. Two: a long scroll being trimmed to a single page, 'Cut the prompt to a page'. Three: a commit node on a version line followed by a play button, 'Commit before you run'. Four: a stop sign beside a notebook, 'Harm stops, form is logged'. Five: a rule sheet going into a bin next to a small component box, 'Delete rules a component makes unnecessary'. Calm, orderly, readable at phone size, no extra steps and no numbers beyond the step order.

Clean editorial infographic, cream background #faf9f5, amber accents, simple flat icons, no photographs. A closing slide with a solid amber panel filling most of the page and white text. The serif headline reads 'Make the process small and boring'. Beneath it, a short line says to spend the rigour on the tool, and that if you are not getting faster, complexity is winning. A simple white line drawing shows a row of small, plain, identical boxes on a conveyor, each shipped and labelled, beside one larger box marked 'tool' under a magnifying glass. At the bottom, in a rounded translucent box, the address sgit.ai/articles/every-mistake-added-a-rule.html invites readers to the full article. Uncluttered, no logos, no figures.
